title: 국회행정심판위원회규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Operation of Committee)
(1) Each meeting of the Committee shall consist of the Chairperson and six members designated by the Chairperson for that meeting, including at least five persons who are not public officials belonging to the National Assembly. [Amended on April 5, 2011.]
(2) Where the Chairperson intends to convene a meeting, the Chairperson shall notify each member in writing of the date and time, place, and agenda of the meeting no later than five days before the meeting. Provided, however, that this shall not apply where urgency requires otherwise.
(3) Deleted on April 5, 2011.
